subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the four exact-pin guards are repaired and exact-head checks pass, should this grouped batch of privileged GitHub Action revisions be approved?
rationale: The consistency repair is mechanical, but authorizing third-party executable revisions in secret-bearing, publishing, and security-scanning workflows requires the designated security owner.

options.title: Repair and approve batch
options.body: Update the guards, verify the exact head, and approve the grouped revisions after security-owner review.

options.title: Split privileged updates
options.body: Move token, registry, CodeQL, and Codex action revisions into narrower separately reviewed pull requests.

recommendation.title: Repair and approve batch
recommendation.body: Update the guards, verify the exact head, and approve the grouped revisions after security-owner review.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS explicitly assigns central affected security workflows and their guard test to this team.
